title: Unfailing Love
lyrics_original: And everything You hold in Your hand
Still You make time for me
Praise You God of Earth and sky
How beautiful is Your unfailing love
And You never change God You remain
The one I hold on to
And everything You hold in Your hand
Still You make time for me
Praise You God of Earth and sky
How beautiful is Your unfailing love
And You never change God You remain
author_english: Carl Richard Pierce, Chris Tomlin, Ed Cash

bible_verses.telugu: నీ చేతిపనియైన నీ ఆకాశములనునీవు కలుగజేసిన చంద్రనక్షత్రములను నేను చూడగా నీవు మనుష్యుని జ్ఞాపకము చేసికొనుటకు వాడేపాటి వాడు?నీవు నరపుత్రుని దర్శించుటకు వాడేపాటివాడు?
bible_verses.english: When I consider your heavens, the work of your fingers, the moon and the stars, which you have set in place, what is mankind that you are mindful of them, human beings that you care for them?

bible_verses.telugu: మన ప్రభువు గొప్పవాడు ఆయన అధిక శక్తిగలవాడు ఆయన జ్ఞానమునకు మితిలేదు.
bible_verses.english: Great is our Lord and mighty in power; his understanding has no limit.

bible_verses.telugu: దేవా, నీ కృప యెంతో అమూల్యమైనది నరులు నీ రెక్కల నీడను ఆశ్రయించుచున్నారు.
bible_verses.english: How priceless is your unfailing love, O God! People take refuge in the shadow of your wings.

devotional.prayer_english: Lord God of Earth and sky, I am in awe that You make time for me. Even with all the power and majesty in Your hands, You care for my heart with gentle tenderness. Thank You for Your unfailing love that catches me when I stumble and holds me close every day. I give myself back to You, trusting in Your endless grace. Amen.
devotional.prayer_original: Lord God of Earth and sky, I am in awe that You make time for me. Even with all the power and majesty in Your hands, You care for my heart with gentle tenderness. Thank You for Your unfailing love that catches me when I stumble and holds me close every day. I give myself back to You, trusting in Your endless grace. Amen.
devotional.reflection_english: It is breathtaking to realize that the God who holds the vast cosmos in His hands also knows and deeply treasures you. Though He spans the Earth and sky, He stoops down to listen, make time, and wrap us in His priceless grace. As we sing of His power and intimate care, we are invited to surrender our hearts back to Him with joyful gratitude. May you rest today in the quiet wonder of a Love that will never let you go.
